source.label: community-2x5060ti-ivanov84-ninfer-windows-tp2
source.notes: Normalized by the maintainer from the contributor fork raw CSV and methodology at commit eb01f69; submitted by an AI agent on behalf of Dmitriy Ivanov.

hardware.pcie: GPU0 CPU-attached PCIe 5.0 x8 under load; GPU1 chipset PCIe 3.0 x4; no CUDA P2P
hardware.notes: MSI PRO Z690-A; native Windows 11 x64 under WDDM.

runtime.notes: NInfer TP2 with CUDA-graph decode and pinned write-back host-memory peer mailbox; canonical post-revert binary.

model.source: Published NInfer Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 artifact, SHA-256 verified by contributor.

serving.notes: CUDA graphs enabled. Small fixed-shape allreduces use the pinned-host mailbox; eager/prefill and oversized payloads retain the staged fallback.

benchmark.notes: Engine-committed decode throughput; greedy temperature 0; output-limit finish. Raw run id: base_mtp0_r1.

caveats: Community-submitted Windows 11 result; not independently reproduced by the maintainer.
Single request with a short synthetic prompt; decode speed and MTP acceptance are workload-dependent.
Native Windows/WDDM mailbox transport result; no matched Linux comparison was measured on this machine.
Prefill numbers use a tiny prompt and should not be treated as sustained long-prompt throughput.
